theorem lg_target {p : ℕ → ℝ} {r : ℝ} (k : ℕ) (hr : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑n * p n) Filter.atTop (nhds r)) : Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(n.choose k) * p n ^ k) Filter.atTop (nhds (r ^ k / ↑k.factorial)) := by
  let f := fun n => ↑(n.choose k) * p n ^ k
  let g := fun n => ↑n * p n
  let h : Filter.Tendsto g Filter.atTop (nhds r) := hr
  let a : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => ↑(n.choose k) / ↑k.factorial
  let b : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => (p n ^ k) / (↑n ^ k)
  have h1 : Filter.Tendsto a Filter.atTop (nhds (r^k / ↑k.factorial)) :=
    by apply tendsto_div; [exact tendsto_const (nhds (r^k)), exact tendsto_const (nhds (↑k.factorial)) ]
  have h2 : Filter.Tendsto b Filter.atTop (nhds (r^k / ↑k.factorial)) :=
    by apply tendsto_div; [exact tendsto_pow' (tendsto_const (nhds r)) k, exact tendsto_const (nhds (↑k.factorial)) ]
  exact (tendsto_mul h1 h2).symm
